reviews.title: Good app but I’m confused
reviews.text: I don’t want to sound mean or anything but I loved the old layout but now I don’t know how to use it and I personally can’t read Arabic but the old version helped me but now I can’t read it and it makes me sad so if you can I would appreciate it if you bought everything back from the old layout

reviews.title: Update destroyed the app
reviews.text: Used to be good until their latest update. The app does not work anymore. Looking for a new app and will delete on my apple phone. App works great on my android because the update wasn’t pushed there yet.

reviews.title: Worst update
reviews.text: The app used to have some issues (like not saving notes) but at least it was easy to read, the font was beautiful, English and Arabic were both displayed elegantly and you could actually increase text size. Now they went backwards and feel like those cheap cookie cutter Quran apps where you just flip pages and listen to audio. Absolutely horrible. I’ll keep this app for a couple more months see if they realize their mistake and bring us the old app back otherwise I am deleting it

reviews.title: Login system
reviews.text: Please Add login system in app as the web.

reviews.title: Too many technical issues
reviews.text: You need to be god at navigating this app. There are many benefits of having it and the audio sound is excellent but I can’t seem to find the same page gain. Lines repeat a lot that I’ve read and I can’t find my place again. Highlighted parts don’t match the audio. You can’t enlarge the words even though you can choose many scripts. I can’t save where I last left off even though i am meant to be able to so I can’t rely rely on it
